newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock funds got $257 mln in 2 days - survey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock funds got $257 mln in 2 days - survey.

text.p: About $257 million flowed into U.S. stock funds in the two days ended Oct 7, according to a survey by Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.
The fund tracking firm said that aggressive growth funds saw inflows decline sharply to $31 million from $318 million for the three days that ended Oct 3.
Growth and income funds got an inflow of $156 million for the period ended October 7, versus $313 million.
International stock funds had an inflow of $154 million, a sharp drop from the previous three-day period of $369 million.
For the two-day period ending Oct 7, bond funds took in $34 million, with the government/GNMA sector capturing $15 million of the total.
High-yield funds had an outflow of $3 million, versus an inflow of $125 million the previous period.
Municipal funds had an outflow of $35 million, compared with a large inflow of $494 million for the previous period.
